newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks mixed at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks mixed at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were mixed at the start of trading Tuesday as a weak bond market proved to be a drag on attempts to follow through on yesterday's strength.
The Dow Industrials opened up four at 6, 560 before turning down. The Nasdaq Composite was up two at 1,253, while the S&P Index rose fractionally to 762.
The 30-year long bond was off 9/32 to yield 7.09 percent as Wall Street opened.
